After existing precharge qualification close KB, keep both precharge contacts energized until electrical bypass proof succeeds.

PC_REARM sits between confirmed isolation and PC_REPROVE: wait for first KT trigger plus at least the final board timer maximum rounded upward, and physical PROOF_WINDOW low continuously2ms. Existing provisional131433us is conservative only for the previous191k1% allocation; derive actual frozen value from selected timer resistor/tolerance.

During RUN both coils remain off. Fault/stop removes PWM and all coils; do not reclose precharge contacts to discharge or recover a fault. Any contact/feedback error latches fault; manual inspection/new POST and separate reset/start are required.
